question.prompt: The corpus does not state how test data with High and Low priorities is made available, and this use-case has no priority-editing flow to create those values during the test.

options.label: Assume seeded tasks
options.detail: Author scenarios and tests assuming the environment provides at least one visible task with High priority and one visible task with Low priority.

options.label: Provide setup source
options.detail: Supply a source or setup reference that explains how High- and Low-priority tasks are created or seeded.

content.risk_rationale: Allowed-value coverage is incomplete without a way to surface non-default priorities, but the default-Medium behavior can still be designed.
